prompt: clang init_seg library init_priority value Windows
answer:
On Windows, Clang maps `init_seg` values to these initialization priorities:

| `init_seg` value | Priority |
|---|---:|
| `compiler` | 200 |
| `library` | 400 |
| `user` | 65535 (default) |

Lower numeric values are initialized earlier. Note that Microsoft’s syntax uses `lib`, while Clang’s documentation refers to `library`.
